decisions.reason: This naval vessel lighting system fits the firm's long-standing specialist, standards-driven lighting capabilities for demanding transport environments, so its absorptive capacity to refine and support it is strong despite the niche market.
A general interior luminaire sits close to the firm's core building-lighting knowledge base, making it easy to learn from early market feedback and improve within the established product family.

This pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics is highly related to the firm's mainstream application-specific indoor lighting business and was still being highlighted in 2024, suggesting a low likelihood of withdrawal.

The marine searchlight remains aligned with the firm's specialist robust-lighting expertise and benefits from existing engineering and testing capabilities, though its narrower market and portfolio rationalization risk make it somewhat more exposed than core indoor products.
